pages.intro: One entry per landing page. Set a hero image and, optionally, override its headline copy. Leave any field empty to use the designed text.
pages.uploadError: Unable to upload the image. Please try again.
pages.noImageSet: No image set — the page uses its designed default.
pages.copyOverridesHint: Leave empty to use the designed text.
pages.homeHeadlineFixed: The homepage headline is fixed by design.

homepage.intro: Choose which stays and trips lead the homepage. Leave everything unchecked to let WEEMAP pick automatically.
homepage.autoRuleStays: With no featured stays chosen, the homepage shows the current lineup ranked by the site's own ordering — never invented.
homepage.autoRuleTrips: With no featured trips chosen, the "Happening now" rail fills itself from real signals — a trip marked featured, a live discount, or the soonest upcoming date — falling back to a curated pick only when nothing else qualifies.

seo.intro: Global defaults used when a page has nothing more specific of its own.
seo.derivedNote: Trips, packages, stays, experiences and products always derive their SEO title and description from their own record — these fields only cover pages that have no such record (the homepage, and any page without a dedicated SEO title).

navigation.navExplainer: The site navigation is part of the designed layout and isn't editable here — changing it needs a code change.
navigation.footerExplainer: The footer's contact details (WhatsApp, phone, email, social links, address) come from Settings.
